steps.sql: SELECT HASHBYTES('MD2', 'abc') AS c0, HASHBYTES('MD2', N'abc') AS c1, HASHBYTES('MD2', '') AS c2
SELECT HASHBYTES('MD4', 'abc') AS c0, HASHBYTES('MD4', N'abc') AS c1, HASHBYTES('MD4', '') AS c2
SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5', 'abc') AS c0, HASHBYTES('MD5', N'abc') AS c1, HASHBYTES('MD5', '') AS c2
SELECT HASHBYTES('SHA', 'abc') AS c0, HASHBYTES('SHA', N'abc') AS c1, HASHBYTES('SHA', '') AS c2
SELECT HASHBYTES('SHA1', 'abc') AS c0, HASHBYTES('SHA1', N'abc') AS c1, HASHBYTES('SHA1', '') AS c2
SELECT HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', 'abc') AS c0, HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', N'abc') AS c1, HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', '') AS c2
SELECT HASHBYTES('SHA2_512', 'abc') AS c0, HASHBYTES('SHA2_512', N'abc') AS c1, HASHBYTES('SHA2_512', '') AS c2
SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5', NULL) AS c0
SELECT HASHBYTES(NULL, 'abc') AS c0, HASHBYTES('md5', 'abc') AS c1, HASHBYTES(N'Sha2_256', 0x616263) AS c2, HASHBYTES('MD5', CAST(NULL AS varchar(10))) AS c3
SELECT HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', REPLICATE(CAST('a' AS varchar(max)), 10000)) AS c0, HASHBYTES('SHA1', REPLICATE('abcdefgh', 100)) AS c1
SELECT HASHBYTES('SHA2_512', 'The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog') AS c0, HASHBYTES('MD5', 'The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog') AS c1
SELECT HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CAST(1 AS int)) AS c0
SELECT HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CAST('abc' AS char(5))) AS c0, HASHBYTES('SHA1', N'🦆') AS c1, HASHBYTES('SHA1', CAST('é' AS varchar(5))) AS c2
SELECT HASHBYTES('SHA3_256', 'abc') AS c0
SELECT CASE WHEN HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', 'abc') = HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', 'abc') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS c0
SELECT CHECKSUM(1) AS c0, CHECKSUM(1, 2) AS c1, CHECKSUM('abc') AS c2, CHECKSUM(N'abc') AS c3, CHECKSUM('ABC') AS c4
SELECT CHECKSUM(NULL) AS c0
SELECT CHECKSUM(CAST(1 AS bigint)) AS c0, CHECKSUM(1.5) AS c1, CHECKSUM(CAST('2024-01-01' AS date)) AS c2
SELECT BINARY_CHECKSUM(1) AS c0, BINARY_CHECKSUM('abc') AS c1, BINARY_CHECKSUM('ABC') AS c2, BINARY_CHECKSUM(N'abc') AS c3, BINARY_CHECKSUM(1, 'a') AS c4
SELECT BINARY_CHECKSUM(NULL) AS c0
SELECT BINARY_CHECKSUM('') AS c0, BINARY_CHECKSUM('abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz') AS c1, BINARY_CHECKSUM(0x0102) AS c2
SELECT COMPRESS('abc') AS c0
